subject: general
question: On which date is the National Voters’ Day celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25th January**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is celebrated to encourage voter participation and awareness of electoral processes.
 
• It was first observed in **2011**, promoting the importance of voting among citizens.
 
• The day was first observed by the initiative of the **Election Commission of India**.
 
• The theme for National Voters' Day 2024 is** "Nothing Like Voting, I Vote for Sure." **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **21 January**

 
 
• **Abolition of the Slave Trade Act:** In 1807, the British Parliament passed this act, making it illegal to engage in the slave trade within the British Empire.
 
 
 
• **26 January:**
 
 
• It is celebrated as the day when the **Constitution of India **came into effect in **1950**, marking the transition of India to a republic.
 
• **International Customs Day**: It is observed globally, this day highlights the importance of customs officials and agencies in maintaining border security and facilitating trade.
 
 
 
• **24 January:**
 
 
• **National Girl Child Day (India)**: It is observed to raise awareness about the rights of girls and the importance of their education and health.
 
• **International Day of Education:** It is declared by the United Nations to celebrate the role of education in achieving peace and development.
